image_description: A close-up view of a silver-colored jeweler's loupe (magnifying glass) with a hinged protective cover. The device features two circular lens openings, one larger than the other, set in a metallic frame. The cover is open, revealing text on its inner surface that appears to be mirrored or gibberish. A black rubber eyecup is visible on the left side. The background is a soft, out-of-focus blue-grey gradient.

artifact_observations.location: Inner surface of the hinged metal cover
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text inscribed on the inside of the cover is nonsensical. It appears to be mirrored or alien-like script ('IIIHDTAHME', 'SOIM'), which is a classic AI generation artifact where the model fails to render coherent typography.

There is a dark, rectangular shape in the lower right that seems to merge ambiguously with the background. Its edges are slightly soft and its purpose/identity is unclear, suggesting a minor structural or compositional hallucination.

The pivot screw connecting the cover to the body lacks clear mechanical definition (e.g., slot head or Phillips head). It appears as a simple blurred circle, which is a minor fidelity issue but not a catastrophic failure.
